title.zh: 製造業招募，細節決定留任
title.en: In manufacturing, the details decide retention

body.zh:
製造業職缺最常見的失敗，不是找不到人，而是人來了三個月就走。原因幾乎都一樣：輪班型態、通勤距離、駐廠頻率或加班強度，在面試時沒有講清楚。

我們在推薦人選前會把這些條件逐項確認，並在面談時主動跟人選核對。寧可在推薦階段少掉幾位，也不要在到職後才發現彼此期待落差。
body.en:
Manufacturing searches rarely fail because nobody could be found. They fail when the hire leaves after three months — and the reason is almost always the same: shift pattern, commute, on-site frequency or overtime intensity was never made explicit at interview.

We confirm every one of those before shortlisting and raise them with candidates directly. Better to lose a few from the shortlist than to discover the mismatch after the start date.

title.zh: 我們一定會問清楚的條件

items.zh: 班別型態：常日班、輪三班或四班二輪，以及輪班津貼
items.en: Shift pattern — regular day, three-shift or four-shift rotation, and the allowance attached

items.zh: 廠區位置與交通：是否提供交通車、宿舍或租屋補助
items.en: Site location and commute — shuttle bus, dormitory or housing allowance

items.zh: 加班型態與實際工時，以及加班費計算方式
items.en: Overtime pattern, real working hours and how overtime is calculated

items.zh: 海外派駐的期間、輪調頻率與外派配套
items.en: For overseas assignments: duration, rotation frequency and the expatriate package

body.zh: 整廠建置的人力規劃，越早開始越省成本。可以只做諮詢，不一定要委任。
body.en: Workforce planning for a new plant costs less the earlier it starts. We are happy to advise without an assignment attached.
